description: Copy Venturi components (and the helpers, UI parts and styles they need) into the user’s project as editable source files. Returns where they went, the npm install command to run, and how to import them. Never overwrites the user’s edits unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace files the user edited. Default false.

path.description: Folder for components (default components/venturi, remembered in venturi.json).

projectDir.description: Project root, if not the current directory.

name: add_components
